runner_contract: Trusted code alone owns GameInitializer, complete GameState, exact frozen deck bytes, seed and transition submission.
Each pilot receives only ActorInput plus its own accepted bounded memory; no opponent hand/library/order, seed or engine state enters pilot code.
Every actor step uses the current source/trial/step ActorEpoch and rejects stale input/proposals.
SphinxStageEWholeActor.Unqualified is a terminal capability stop, never fallback, random choice, pass substitution or retry.
Accepted actions are journaled durably before the next actor decision; Ponder reorder/shuffle use the accepted transition journal and exact memory recovery.

Collector records source/deck/opponent/pilot pins, initialization identity, ordered accepted action records, stop classification and terminal engine state; it does not compute deck-performance conclusions.
A separate strict replay reconstructs from the recorded initialization and accepted actions and must reproduce every state-continuity hash before an attempt can be admitted.
pre_stage_e_scope: Deterministic runner/collector qualification fixtures only. No official Stage-E seed/allocation/game is authorized by this freeze.
acceptance: Independent source review plus fresh deterministic runner/collector/replay fixtures with exact source and artifact audit.
next_gate: Implement the smallest trusted runner/collector around the already accepted actor/replay seams; preserve uncovered action surfaces as explicit capability stops.
